title: Bond yields could rise to 7.5% on crude, inflation pressures
summary: Domestic bond yields may rise as much as forty-five basis points. Elevated crude prices and rising inflation expectations weigh on sentiment. The Reserve Bank of India's open market operation sales will increase bond supply. This action drains surplus liquidity from the financial system. Bond traders anticipate yields could reach around seven point five zero percent.

title: MDR on UPI transactions faces PIL in Supreme Court

The Supreme Court will now review this significant financial move.
